text: The Han is wounded, but it yet lives! Ambitious men would place the imperial crown upon my head, as though loyalty were a garment to be discarded when opportunity arises. I will not betray my emperor merely because others have abandoned theirs. The north looks to me for peace, the people for protection, and the dynasty for faithful service. Let other warlords grasp at empty titles and drench the land in blood. I shall govern with virtue, defend the innocent, and preserve what remains of the Han. If China is to endure, then honour must endure with it!

The tyrant holds the emperor captive, while ambitious men gather armies and speak loudly of loyalty. Words alone will not preserve the Han! Yang Province is rich in grain, soldiers and steadfast people; such strength must not be squandered while the realm burns. I will answer the call, arm those who still serve with honour, and lend our strength to the restoration of the court. Yet I must remain vigilant, for those who march against one usurper may soon seek to become another. I shall defend this province, uphold the authority entrusted to me, and ensure that Yang does not become the prize of grasping warlords!
